model: hssr-selection-v11 (hssr_guard.bin): the V11 guard controller, run beside q6d on the control worker; its vocal posterior feeds the vocal veto

AUDIO_HSSR_VOCAL_GATE.what: per-band vocal veto on the rendered object (q6d + guard posterior + per-bin comodulation, held ~0.35 s). 0 = the 22.09 behaviour; 0.95 = master 0ffe8eb without the mask net; 0.5 = the soft veto over the mask net, measured on 40 DEV songs (vocals 4 %, guitars 7 %, 2/40 swinging; 0.95 halves the guitars). Shared with models/mask-full-probe-v21a/settings.json
